description: Hero picture of the house with calm status chips: locks, lights on and indoor climate. Shows the installation's own day/night photo when one is uploaded, otherwise the live sky.
aiSummary: Use as the large centrepiece of a tablet or desktop dashboard to summarize the whole house at a glance.

title.description: Optional heading over the picture, e.g. the house name.

image.description: Base name of the installation images in <data dir>/assets: <image>-day.(webp|jpg|png) and <image>-night.*
